meta.source: Systematic Strava-to-historical-calendar audit + user medal/photo evidence + official event records
meta.policy: Keep unresolved candidates here until the public record can be dated and placed accurately; medals alone do not prove a finish when contemporary event records show cancellation, deferral, virtual options, or automatic medal distribution.

knownEventsPendingDate.evidence: User owns the 2020 B3 Distance Series medal/holder. Contemporary reporting states that the 2020 Shamrock 5K was canceled and registrations were deferred. The deferred Shamrock leg is now independently reconciled to an exact 5.02 km Strava completion on March 14, 2021, the final day of the organizer's virtual window. The medal still does not by itself prove completion of the remaining B3 legs.
knownEventsPendingDate.status: COVID-disrupted series; Shamrock leg resolved, full challenge unresolved
knownEventsPendingDate.reason: The deferred 2020 Shamrock 5K is now published as a verified virtual completion. A 10.04 km Baltimore Strava run on May 30, 2020 remains a plausible virtual Sole of the City 10K candidate, but the permitted completion window or individual result has not yet been recovered. A 19.32 km Denver run on September 5, 2021 remains a strong Charles Street 12 virtual candidate during the 2021 race/virtual period, but an archived virtual result or registration record is still needed. Do not publish a completed B3 challenge until the Sole and Charles Street components are independently resolved.

resolved.candidate: Deferred 2020 Kelly Benefits St. Patrick's Day Shamrock 5K
resolved.reason: The March 15, 2020 in-person race was canceled and registrations were deferred. Organizer instructions for 2020 registrants allowed the 2021 virtual 5K from March 6 through March 14; Strava records exactly 5.02 km on March 14, the final permitted day. This resolves the Shamrock leg without asserting completion of the full B3 series.
